title: THE COMMON PLACE OF THE TWO NATVRES IN CHRIST.

segments.text: The Queſtions here to be obſerued.

1 Whether there be two natures in the Mediatour.
2 Whether they be one, or two perſons.
3 If they be one perſon, what maner of vnion that is of them, and how made.
4 Why this perſonall vnion was neceſſarie to be made.
